newsitem.title: USA: MHM Svcs buys Apogee's long-term care unit.
newsitem.headline: MHM Svcs buys Apogee's long-term care unit.

text.p: MHM Services Inc said Thursday its MHM Extended Care Services Inc unit acquired the long-term care operations of Apogee Inc.
The acquired operations booked revenues of more than $7 million in calendar year 1996. They provide mental health services to about 270 long-term care facilities in Pennsylvania and Tennessee.
The acquisition is expected to be accretive to fiscal 1997 earnings, MHM said.
The company said it paid $100,000 in cash, issued a three-year promissory note for $125,000, and issued 200,000 shares of its common stock for the operations.

Terms of the note call for interest payments six months after the closing date for the first two quarters and quarterly thereafter at an annual interest rate of 7 percent, and annual principal payments.
The company also agreed to pay 20 percent of cash flow, as defined in the agreement, from the acquired operations over a five-year period, payable annually.
